purpose: Make JNU Operational Framework evidence fusion reproducible and prospectively auditable without claiming a validated mechanical directional alpha.

directional_blocks.anti_double_count: All exact-JNU path observations combine into one block vote only.

directional_blocks.role: Which venue/instrument is currently leading the same risk move
examples: CME or other contemporaneous venue only when causally aligned
directional_blocks.anti_double_count: Multiple venues combine into one DPD block; proxy-only evidence cannot receive quality A.

directional_blocks.role: Current synchronized global-risk confirmation, not prior-day prediction
directional_blocks.anti_double_count: All U.S. equity indices, yields, VIX and FX are one block vote. Failed prior-night USDJPY and US-to-JNU predictor families may not be reused.

examples: term structure or basis only as context
directional_blocks.anti_double_count: All derivatives/positioning inputs combine into one block. PCR, foreign-flow and failed basis-change families are prohibited.

quality_definition.A: Exact-product or official contemporaneous data with causal timestamp and no unresolved source ambiguity.
quality_definition.B: High-quality causally aligned context or proxy with clear timestamp and no material source ambiguity.
quality_definition.C: Weak/proxy/stale/ambiguous evidence. Reportable as context but ineligible to cast a directional vote.

vote_rule.eligible_vote: Only A/B BULLISH or BEARISH blocks count. NEUTRAL/UNAVAILABLE and all C-quality blocks count zero.

bias_rule.insufficient_evidence: If fewer than 2 eligible directional block votes exist -> NEUTRAL_ABSTAIN.

confidence_rule.LOW: Any non-abstain bias that does not meet every MEDIUM condition.
MEDIUM_conditions: at least one aligned quality-A block

HAR_RSV_VOLATILITY_STATE.HIGH: Cap MEDIUM directional confidence to LOW. Does not flip direction.
HAR_RSV_VOLATILITY_STATE.UNKNOWN: Treat as unavailable risk state; cap MEDIUM directional confidence to LOW. Does not vote direction.

BOJ_OR_MAJOR_EVENT_STATE.PRE_RELEASE_HIGH: If the event occurs before the target close and no exact-JNU post-event price-path evidence exists, force NEUTRAL_ABSTAIN for the formally scored forecast.
BOJ_OR_MAJOR_EVENT_STATE.POST_EVENT_HIGH: Cap MEDIUM to LOW until exact-JNU price-path acceptance/rejection is observed.
BOJ_OR_MAJOR_EVENT_STATE.UNKNOWN: If event calendar/state cannot be verified for the target horizon, force NEUTRAL_ABSTAIN for the formally scored forecast.

DYNAMIC_SQ_RISK.UNRESOLVED_HIGH: Cap MEDIUM to LOW. SQ bias cannot vote direction by itself.
DYNAMIC_SQ_RISK.UNKNOWN: Treat as unresolved risk; cap MEDIUM to LOW. Does not vote direction.

prohibited_directional_inputs: JPX Tokyo & Nagoya cash foreign-flow sign
output_requirements: explicit statement that the bias is operational/shadow-validated-pending rather than calibrated alpha
probability_rule: Do not transform net score or confidence into a calibrated probability. Scenario weights may be stated only as explicitly non-calibrated judgmental weights.
live_shadow_rule: Every scored live-shadow forecast must preserve the decision trace produced by this protocol.
amendment_reason: Real live-shadow ledger is 0/0. Add UNKNOWN fail-safe risk states so unavailable HAR/event/SQ inputs are never fabricated as NORMAL or HIGH.
